name: JCY International Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份分拆/附加上市及例行财报，未见有关业务板块扩张、新增、缩减、出售或获得合约的具体公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长62.3%至179,146,000 MYR，净利润2,458,000 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly additional listing/subdivision of shares and routine financial reports; no specific announcements regarding business segment expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins were observed. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue increased 62.3% YoY to MYR 179,146,000, with net profit of MYR 2,458,000.
